name: minimal file fills every default
service defaults to host root and keeps index metadata
index.purpose defaults to empty string when given
toml:
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[[service]]
name = "api"
[service.index]
label = "API"
purpose = "the API"

name: two services share a host when their paths differ
toml:
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[[service]]
name = "web"
[[service]]
name = "api"
path = "/api"
port = 3000

name: duplicate host root claim
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.1.subdomain: the host root is already claimed by another service

name: duplicate path claim on the host root
toml:
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[[service]]
name = "web"
[[service]]
name = "api"
path = "/api"
[[service]]
name = "api2"
path = "/api"
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.2.path: the host root at path "/api" is already claimed by another service

name: duplicate claim on a named subdomain
toml:
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[[service]]
name = "a"
subdomain = "app"
[[service]]
name = "b"
subdomain = "app"
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.1.subdomain: subdomain "app" is already claimed by another service

name: duplicate service name
toml:
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[[service]]
name = "api"
subdomain = "a"
[[service]]
name = "api"
subdomain = "b"
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.1.name: duplicate service name "api"

name: duplicate name and duplicate route reported for the same service
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.1.name: duplicate service name "api"
  service.1.subdomain: the host root is already claimed by another service

name: path with backtick and Host() injection rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.0.path: must be a URL path starting with /, without spaces, quotes, backticks, $, ? or #; % must be followed by two hex digits

name: path with bad percent-escape rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.0.path: must be a URL path starting with /, without spaces, quotes, backticks, $, ? or #; % must be followed by two hex digits

name: path with query string rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.0.path: must be a URL path starting with /, without spaces, quotes, backticks, $, ? or #; % must be followed by two hex digits

name: path with dollar sign rejected (Compose would interpolate it)
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.0.path: must be a URL path starting with /, without spaces, quotes, backticks, $, ? or #; % must be followed by two hex digits

name: path with RFC 3986 punctuation and percent-escapes accepted
path of just the root slash accepted
subdomain starting with a hyphen rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.0.subdomain: must be lower-case letters, digits, and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen

name: subdomain ending with a hyphen rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.0.subdomain: must be lower-case letters, digits, and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen

name: subdomain over 63 characters rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.0.subdomain: must be at most 63 characters

name: subdomain of exactly 63 characters accepted
domain label over 63 characters rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  project.domain: each label must be at most 63 characters

name: domain over 125 characters rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  project.domain: must be at most 125 characters, so that <subdomain>.<slug>.<domain> fits in a hostname

name: domain of exactly 125 characters accepted
domain with underscore rejected as not a valid hostname
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  project.domain: must be a valid hostname

name: unknown top-level key rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  compose: Unrecognized key: "bogus"

name: two unknown top-level keys listed in file order
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  (root): Unrecognized keys: "zeta", "alpha"

name: unknown key under [project] rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  project: Unrecognized key: "bogus"

name: unknown key under [compose] rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  compose: Unrecognized key: "bogus"

name: unknown key on a service element rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:

name: unknown key under service.index rejected
toml:
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[[service]]
name = "api"
[service.index]
label = "API"
extra = 1
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.0.index: Unrecognized key: "extra"

name: unknown keys inside [hooks] rejected
want:

name: control-home rejected: that path is per-machine, not committed
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  project: Unrecognized key: "control-home"

name: label-namespace accepted when it looks like a reverse domain
label-namespace rejected when it is not a reverse domain
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  project.label-namespace: must look like a reverse domain, e.g. dev.example

name: port over 65535 rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.0.port: Too big: expected number to be <=65535

name: port of zero rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.0.port: Too small: expected number to be >=1

name: port of exactly 1 accepted
port of exactly 65535 accepted
fractional port rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.0.port: Invalid input: expected int, received number

name: port written as 80.0 accepted as the integer 80
port of 1e20, integral but beyond a safe integer, rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.0.port: Too big: expected int to be <=9007199254740991
  service.0.port: Too big: expected number to be <=65535

name: port of -1e20 rejected as below a safe integer and below 1
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.0.port: Too small: expected int to be >=-9007199254740991
  service.0.port: Too small: expected number to be >=1

toml:
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[[service]]
name = "a"
port = inf
want:

name: port given as a string rejected

name: missing project.name rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  project.name: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined

name: missing [project] table rejected

name: missing [compose] table rejected

want:

  compose.file: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined

name: empty compose.file rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  compose.file: Too small: expected string to have >=1 characters

name: project.name of the wrong type rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  project.name: Invalid input: expected string, received number

name: project.domain of the wrong type rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  project.domain: Invalid input: expected string, received number

name: project.name with uppercase or symbols rejected

test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:

name: several issues at once, unrecognized key reported last
toml:
[project]
name = "BAD NAME"
domain = 5

[compose]

[[service]]
name = "BAD"

bogus = true
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  project.name: must be lower-case letters, digits, and hyphens
  project.domain: Invalid input: expected string, received number
  compose.file: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined
  service.0.name: must be lower-case letters, digits, and hyphens
  service.0: Unrecognized key: "bogus"

name: a non-fatal issue does not suppress the duplicate-service check
toml:
[project]
name = "BAD NAME"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "x"

[[service]]
name = "api"
[[service]]
name = "api"
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  project.name: must be lower-case letters, digits, and hyphens
  service.1.name: duplicate service name "api"
  service.1.subdomain: the host root is already claimed by another service

name: a missing required field suppresses the duplicate-service check
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  project.name: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined

name: an unrecognized key on one service suppresses the duplicate-service check
toml:

name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[[service]]
name = "web"
bogus = 1
[[service]]

want:

name: empty [hooks] table
hooks with an empty string value rejected
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  hooks.prepare: Too small: expected string to have >=1 characters

name: all five hook stages configured
toml:

name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[hooks]
prepare = "./prepare.sh"
seed = "./seed.sh"
verify = "./verify.sh"
backup = "./backup.sh"
restore = "./restore.sh"

name: a table between two [[service]] blocks leaves both services whole
toml:

domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[[service]]
name = "api"
[hooks]
verify = "./check.sh"
[[service]]
name = "mail"
subdomain = "mail"

name: an index table after an interleaved table belongs to the service above it
toml:
[[service]]
name = "api"
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"
[[service]]
name = "mail"
subdomain = "mail"
[service.index]
label = "Mail"
[compose]
file = "compose.yaml"

name: unknown keys in an interleaved second service are reported in file order
toml:
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

[[service]]
name = "api"
[hooks]
seed = "./seed.sh"
[[service]]
zeta = 1
name = "mail"
alpha = 2
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  service.1: Unrecognized keys: "zeta", "alpha"

name: an inline array of service tables
toml:
[project]
name = "acme"
domain = "acme.localhost"

[compose]
file = "docker/compose.yaml"

service = [{ name = "api" }, { name = "mail", subdomain = "mail" }]
want:
test.toml is not a valid berth.toml:
  compose: Unrecognized key: "service"

name: invalid TOML reported distinctly from invalid configuration
want:

1:  [project
     ^
2:  name =

name: invalid TOML: unterminated string
want:
test.toml is not valid TOML: Invalid TOML document: unfinished string

8:  extra = "unterminated
            ^
